methodology.scope: All baseline candidate Go paths UNION every added/deleted/modified Go path anywhere since accepted baseline. Independent full-repository Go comparison must give identical deltas. No moved code excluded. Production is every .go except *_test.go, including scripts/build-tag files consistently before/after. Physical lines include blanks/comments. Declaration regexes are lexical counts, not semantic API reachability. Duplicate method names count as declarations. Imports/reverse consumers include tests and are package-level, not proof every symbol is called. README/skills/docs/catalogs inventoried separately in report.
